PrivateKey = object
  case kind*: PrivKeyKind
  of pkRsa:
    rsa*: rsaAlgo.RsaPrivateKey
  of pkEc:
    ec*: ecdsaAlgo.EcPrivateKey
  of pkEd25519:
    edSecret*: array[64, byte]
    edPub*: array[32, byte]
  of pkX25519:
    xSeed*: array[32, byte]
PrivKeyKind = enum
  pkRsa, pkEc, pkEd25519, pkX25519
